notes: Encoder::new(BitOrder::Lsb, 8) and Decoder::new(BitOrder::Lsb, 8) with the one-call encode and decode, the same variant as Go's lzw.LSB. The crate has no level. A new encoder is made per call.
details: Encoder::new(BitOrder::Lsb, 8) and Decoder::new(BitOrder::Lsb, 8), with the one-call encode and decode, the same variant as Go's lzw.LSB with 8-bit literals. The crate has no compression level. A new encoder is made for each call.
